projects.name: Intelligent Bistro
projects.description: An AI-powered restaurant ordering app that replaces keyword search with natural-language ordering and mood detection. Gemini 2.5 Flash drives the chat assistant and personalized recommendations, with a Node.js and Express backend and a React Native (Expo) frontend.
highlights: Menu of 40 items across 6 cuisines, each tagged by mood for personalized recommendations.
Detects one of 8 moods from free text and opens with a tailored message plus 2–3 matching dishes.
Sends the last 6 chat messages with each request so follow-ups like "yes, add those" work.

projects.name: Hydrate Yourself
projects.description: A consumer health utility built after a competitive analysis of wellness apps surfaced user pain points around advertising and privacy. It is a zero-commercialization Flutter app with fully on-device storage, published on Google Play.
highlights: Shipped to the Google Play Store with a 5.0 rating.
Zero commercialization: no ads, with all data stored on the device.

projects.name: Financial Forecasting System
projects.description: NYU graduate research project: a multimodal forecasting platform that pairs financial-news sentiment with S&P 500 price data. Agentic workflows handle automated model evaluation.
highlights: Designed agentic workflows for automated model evaluation.

projects.name: mcpgate
projects.description: A security gateway for the Model Context Protocol that fronts many MCP servers as one. Every tool call passes through OAuth bearer validation, per-client RBAC, rate limits, schema validation and a tamper-evident audit log.
highlights: Tool-definition pinning with a SHA-256 hash quarantines tools whose definitions change after approval.

projects.name: agentguard
projects.description: A capability-based permission engine for LLM agent tool calls. YAML policies, argument constraints, taint tracking and human approvals sit between the model and its tools, and every decision goes into a hash-chained audit log.
highlights: Ten-stage decision procedure with default-deny, least-privilege grants per task.
Includes an Ollama-based agent loop, sandboxed fake tools and a scenario suite that checks injected instructions cannot move money or data.

projects.name: planprice
projects.description: An offline Go CLI that prices Terraform plans and diffs monthly cost between two plans from a pinned AWS price snapshot. It outputs PR-ready Markdown and can gate CI on cost increases.
highlights: Embedded 1.8 MB curated price snapshot, so estimates need no network or AWS credentials.
CI gate exits with code 3 when the monthly increase exceeds a set dollar or percent threshold.

projects.name: dagcache
projects.description: A content-addressed, parallel pipeline runner for reproducible ML workflows. It hashes each stage's code, parameters and input data into a cache key, reruns only what changed, and explains why a stage is stale.
highlights: About 4,600 lines of typed Python with 165 tests.
Local or S3-compatible remote cache, with lineage tracing for any artifact.

projects.name: Spotify Listening Analytics
projects.description: A data engineering platform that pulls personal Spotify listening history, playlists and audio features via OAuth 2.0. It builds a dimensional model in Snowflake with SCD Type 2 tracking and serves a Streamlit dashboard.
highlights: Dashboard covers genre evolution, a mood heatmap, an audio-feature radar and top artists and tracks.
13 unit tests cover OAuth, pagination, sessionization and rate-limit handling.

projects.name: Weather Data Pipeline
projects.description: A weather data pipeline that collects hourly observations for 50+ global cities from the Open-Meteo API. It validates each batch with Great Expectations and transforms data with dbt into analytics-ready BigQuery tables.
highlights: Quality gates halt the pipeline and send a Slack alert when validation fails.
21 unit tests pass; hourly runs are orchestrated with Prefect.
